sentences.en: That evening tea was partaken of in a grim silence.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上喝茶时气氛沉闷，一片寂静。

sentences.en: There was complete silence. You could hear a pin drop.
sentences.zh: 房间里静悄悄的。连针掉地上都能听得见。

sentences.en: We were awed into silence when we heard the story.
sentences.zh: 听到那个故事后我们都惊呆了，一句话也说不出来。

senses.zh: 沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态
使沉默；使安静；压制；消除噪音
